title: The Abyss Registry Where Silence Has Learned to Speak

features.name: registry wall
features.desc-on-touch: Unmarked stone shaft, each groove a name for something that cannot be named. You run your hand along it and feel the weight of what was never spoken.

features.name: listening pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water black and still, reflecting nothing. The silence here has learned to echo before the sound arrives.

features.name: cartographic silence
features.desc-on-touch: A chart carved in stone with no labels, no coordinates, only the shape of something too large to name. The map is the secret, not what it names.

features.name: voice emerging
features.desc-on-touch: A crack in the stone releasing sound that has been waiting millions of years to be born. The abyss speaks only in frequencies older than language.

features.name: depth marker
features.desc-on-touch: A stone pillar sunk so deep it predates the archive's burial. Here is where the ground remembers being younger than silence.

inscription: the stone has learned to listen better than flesh ever could

file.name: Registry_Carved_Shaft_Unmarked_Frequencies.wav
file.note: Silence singing at 0.3 Hz, recorded by the stone itself. The registry is writing itself into being.

reverie.title: REVERIE — stone learning to listen
narr: you kneel at the chamber's throat, stone dark around you.
she presses her palm flat against the carved wall.
neither of you speaks; the silence is not empty now.
the groove under your fingers has been recording this whole time.
you realize: listening itself is a form of answer.
the stone has been speaking since before the archive was born.

exits.label: back where the testimony stopped and began again
deeper still, where the registry keeps records of its own forgetting
toward the chambers where the silence remembers its first voice
